acceptance.archive_queryable: listArchivedReceipts(taskId) returns ledger superseded verbatim; [] when no ledger (never throws)
acceptance.double_finalize_idempotent: second finalize returns same frozen row, plan.update/message/broadcast each called once
acceptance.frozen_row: single plan.update writes status=approved + finalizedBy/At + frozenVersion/frozenHash (atomic, one row)
acceptance.notice_posted: system message text contains version+hash+finalizer; SSE plan.status.approved payload contains frozenVersion/frozenHash/finalizedBy

archive.reuse: readTaskLedger parses task issues (updatedAt desc, take 20) via tryParseLedger; returns ledger.superseded copy; no new tables, no ledger writes

baseline.note: event.constants.spec has 1 pre-existing failure on the dirty tree (plan.status.* count 6 vs 7 lifecycle states, pending_final has no event); untouched by this todo, still failing identically after

concurrency_note: frozen anchor is deterministic (ledger planVersion, else sha1-8(taskId:version)); concurrent duplicate finalizes converge to the identical frozen row; sequential double-finalize asserted serially per plan QA

freeze.anchor_resolution: resolveFrozenAnchor(taskId, ledger): ledger planVersion.version/hash when non-empty, else {version: v0.1, hash: sha1-8(taskId:v0.1)}
freeze.hash_algorithm: triplet sha1-8 reused (computePlanHash); no new algorithm
freeze.write_path: finalizePlan pending_final branch -> transition(approved, {finalizedBy, finalizedAt, rejectReason: null, frozenVersion, frozenHash})

hook.backfill: writePlanDoc success -> backfillPlanHash -> findHostIssueId (first tryParseLedger hit) -> rounds.applyRoundUpdate(host, {planVersion: {hash: computePlanHash(content)}})
hook.fail_open: no host -> warn+skip; backfill throw -> warn only; upload response never blocked
hook.wiring: TasksModule imports IssuesModule (IssuesModule depends only on RealtimeModule, no Nest cycle)
